status: locally validated within separately recorded inventory scope; not organizer acceptance or slot approval
hypothesis: Every prior GEMSDOE77 lane froze the emitter at 37,654 binary dots with min_sep 2.8 px and optimised only the surface. The published metric is a distance-weighted Tversky index (alpha 0.2 FP, beta 0.8 FN, 300 m triangular kernel): a missed truth cell costs 4x an over-prediction and any prediction inside the kernel earns graded credit, so a fixed budget caps recall and a greedy top-N on a surface trained on the catalogue is absorbed by the catalogue collar. The competition truth is off-catalogue by construction.
mechanism: (1) 3.5 px (350 m) collar excluding every mapped trace from emission; (2) 1-px 3x3 local-maximum skeleton so support is thin and no redundant FP mass is paid twice; (3) support size set to 3.3x the truth-cell count, the scale-free optimum measured on two independent hide-and-recover draws.
named_non_fault_mimicking_process: Plio-Pleistocene Lake Lahontan shoreline benches and fluvial terrace risers produce the same slope-break/curvature signature as a fault scarp; 100 m alluvial-fan and basalt-flow contacts add linear gradients that are not faults.
label_free_surface: 37 channels derived only from the 19 official training_features.tif bands (z-scores, gradient energy, Laplacian/ridge curvature, 5 px texture, cross-sensor coupling). No catalogue, no GDR, no LiDAR, no distance-to-mapped-fault channel, so nothing can transfer from the catalogue through a tautology (the failure mode logged as IRR-03).

holdout_dti.instrument: hide-and-recover: whole catalogue components withheld per quadrant with a 3 px feature buffer; every catalogue-based feature of that fold is rebuilt from visible faults only; visible faults masked pixel-exactly

selector.basis: Owner standing instruction: a unique TIF must exist and its download/submit status must be unambiguous. This is the only candidate in the repository that both beats the retained holdout best on two independent draws and passes the like-for-like uniqueness rule. Weekly slot selection stays with the owner.

limitations: Two-seed local holdout, not a leaderboard score; no organizer receipt exists for any file in this repository.
Support ratio 3.3x is calibrated on withheld *catalogue* faults; the live new-fault count is unpublished, so a 2x error in that count moves support from ~100k to ~400k px.
The remote 836-entry registry index was not materialised; uniqueness is measured against the rasters present in this checkout.
The 37-channel surface is a single HGB fit per draw; no deep model, no DEM-derived scarp channels, no external datasets.
